example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পটি হাড়পেকের বোঝা হয়ে দাঁড়িয়েছে।
পরিবারের দায়িত্বটা তার কাছে হাড়পেকের বোঝা।
example_sentences_in_english: This project has turned into a bone-picker's burden.
The family responsibilities feel like a bone-picker's burden to him.
history: The idiom draws from the traditional role of bone-pickers (হাড়পেকা) in rural Bengal, who scavenged animal remains, symbolizing menial and exhausting labor.
note: Reflects socio-economic realities of rural scavenging professions in Bengali culture.
